acquisition_note: Metadata only. Every candidate is completed to the plan §13.2 field set, but no asset is downloaded, hashed, executed, or network-accessed. Each entry stays ineligible until a separately authorized per-model download plan pins its revision and asset_sha256 (Phase 11 ticket 04); model downloads never reuse media-download authorization and vice versa.

candidates.purpose: Primary ASR for zh+en mixed speech (D1).
candidates.usage_restrictions: None beyond Apache-2.0; credential-free. Upstream weights: Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B (Apache-2.0).
candidates.notes: 8-bit first per plan §2.2; 4-bit is the recorded over-envelope fallback. A missing 8-bit variant resolves in this model's download-plan confirmation, never silently.

candidates.purpose: Second ASR that reviews only suspect intervals (D2).
candidates.usage_restrictions: MLX conversion is MIT; upstream openai/whisper-large-v3 weights are Apache-2.0. Credential-free.
candidates.notes: mlx-whisper needs ffmpeg (already identity-pinned in config/tools.json) and supports word timestamps.

candidates.purpose: Forced alignment of transcript to audio PTS (D3).
candidates.usage_restrictions: None beyond Apache-2.0; credential-free. Upstream: Qwen/Qwen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B (Apache-2.0).
candidates.notes: Shares the mlx-audio runtime with asr_primary. Aligner has a hard input window; VAD-derived <=5-minute chunking (ticket 06) is the shared upstream.

candidates.purpose: Voice-activity detection and the shared <=5-minute chunking upstream for ASR and alignment (D4).
candidates.notes: Vendored .onnx carried directly (pinned by v6.2.1 git tag + file sha256), inferred through onnxruntime; the silero-vad pip package is NOT installed, keeping the whole torch stack out. onnxruntime is shared with diarization and ocr_primary.

candidates.purpose: Speaker-segmentation stage of the credential-free sherpa-onnx diarization pipeline (D5).
candidates.usage_restrictions: pyannote/segmentation-3.0 model card is MIT ('will always remain open-source'); the ONNX conversion is distributed as a credential-free sherpa-onnx release asset. No credentials, no paid service.
candidates.notes: First of two diarization assets that fill the recorded Diarization capability vacancy. Speaker labels stay anonymous and Part-local (no true names). Pairs with 3dspeaker-campplus-zh-en-advanced. Excludes credential-gated pyannote hub access; runs via onnxruntime under sherpa-onnx.

candidates.purpose: Bilingual speaker-embedding stage of the sherpa-onnx diarization pipeline (D5).
candidates.usage_restrictions: Apache-2.0 confirmed via the ModelScope API; distributed as a credential-free sherpa-onnx release asset. No credentials, no paid service.
candidates.notes: Second of two diarization assets. zh+en embedding chosen for the mixed-language corpus; paired with sherpa-onnx-pyannote-segmentation-3-0 and clustering.

candidates.model_id: rapidocr (PyPI wheel, bundled PP-OCRv6 small det+rec + v4 mobile cls)
candidates.purpose: Primary OCR for zh+en text-bearing frames (D6).
candidates.usage_restrictions: RapidOCR code Apache-2.0; bundled models are PaddleOCR-derived (Baidu copyright) under the PaddleOCR repository's Apache-2.0. Credential-free. License/source approved by the maintainer 2026-08-16.
candidates.notes: Model ships inside the pinned rapidocr==3.9.2 wheel (no separate model download); the registry entry records the wheel version and the bundled model files are hashed at acquisition (ticket 11). onnxruntime CPU EP is sufficient. Supersedes the pre-Phase-11 metadata-only research-candidate state now that license and source are approved.

candidates.purpose: Text semantics (zh+en summaries and JSON) for the new text_semantics capability (D7).
candidates.usage_restrictions: None beyond Apache-2.0; credential-free. Upstream: Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (Apache-2.0).
candidates.notes: 8-bit first per plan §2.2; the research-recommended 4-bit (2.26 GB) is the recorded fallback. A missing 8-bit variant resolves in this model's download-plan confirmation, never silently. Runs with deterministic sampling (mlx-lm --temp/--seed) and bounded KV memory (ticket 10).
